Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. I've pulled together the items you asked for and attached two working docs to speed the process: our SLA & support contact template and a short PO/invoicing instruction PDF.

Quick answers up front:
- Support contacts: primary on-call (24/7) + technical account lead (business hours) + escalation manager (exec escalation) — see attached template for names/placeholders.
- Escalation paths: P1 -> on-call triage -> Triage lead -> Escalation manager -> Executive on-call (timeline and phone numbers in template).
- Uptime targets: Hosted API: 99.9% monthly availability standard; Dedicated: 99.95% (higher SLA options available via Dedicated contracts).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You fill the attached Redwood_SLA_Contact_Template.xlsx with Sigma's preferred contacts and any required notification emails/phone numbers.
2) Return the completed vendor/setup form to accounting@redwood.ai so we can provision the vendor record and generate a PO acceptance form.
3) If you want a short kickoff call to walk the PO flow and support handoffs, I can book 30 minutes next week — Markus (cc) can cover Dedicated account requirements.

Attachments: [Redwood_SLA_Contact_Template.xlsx] [PO_instructions_v2.pdf]

Thanks — I'll monitor for the completed forms and schedule the call if you prefer.

Hi Liam / team — quick technical clarifications from the Dedicated/Private side so procurement can note any extra needs: 

- Support tiers: Standard (business hours + email), Premium (24/7 on-call + phone escalation), Enterprise (dedicated TAC + guaranteed response windows).
- Typical response SLOs (for Enterprise customers): P1: 1 hour ack, 4 hour remediation target; P2: 4 hour ack, 24 hour resolution target.
- Escalation contacts: primary on-call (phone), TAC lead (phone+pager), and if the issue qualifies as an outage we have an Executive Incident Manager assigned. All contact slots are in the attached template; we can pre-fill once Sigma confirms team members.
- On PO items: to avoid delays, include Redwood legal entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), billing address, and the internal PO number in the invoice PDF. Accounting processes electronic invoices via invoices@redwood.ai (CC accounting@redwood.ai for exceptions).

Happy to jump on the kickoff call to run through scenario examples (P1/P2) if helpful.

-Markus
